description: A for expression over an unknown list gives the dynamic value even if its body is invalid
notes: The spec gives the dynamic value for an unknown collection only when the results are otherwise type-valid, and v.b is invalid for every element of this list type; a splat over the same list reports the error (splat-unknown-list-missing-attribute-fails). ForExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) returns the dynamic value for an unknown collection before it evaluates the body.
